name: X7 Finance X7Pioneer claimRewards
summary: X7Pioneer.claimRewards adds the contract's unaccounted ETH (balance minus lastETHBalance) to totalRewards on every call but refreshes lastETHBalance only when something is claimed, so calls with an empty tokenIds array re-count the same delta. The attacker donated flash-loaned WETH as ETH, inflated totalRewards with repeated empty claims, and claimed the whole pool with one owned NFT.
notes: All 508 earlier claimRewards/transferFrom calls since deployment paid at most 0.19 ETH each; none repeats the empty-array inflation. The contract exists only on Ethereum.
Loss is the pool's net ETH outflow in the anchor: the 33.76 ETH claimed minus the attacker's 26.96 ETH donation, which came back in the same claim.
